content: I just repeated your archive action with a message being stored in one of my folders created in Local Folders and saw it disappear without knowing where it had gone. Since Thunderbird has a global search feature I typed the "From" name in the search field and showed the results as lists. I found that the archived message was now located in the 2026 subfolder of the Archives folder of my POP account where it initially had been downloaded before I had moved it in my "Documents" folder in Local Folders. So you should use the global search function, display the search results as list and activate the "Account" and "Location" columns.

Es handelt sich hierbei um den Bug https://bugzilla.mozilla.org/show_bug.cgi?id=2077553 in der aktuellen Version. Einstweilen kannst du eine provisorische Lösung (workaround) benutzen, die den schwarzen Hintergrund im Bearbeitungsfenster durch eine helle Farbe ersetzt und somit den schwarzen Text sichtbar macht. Diese Lösung habe ich in der folgenden Diskussion beschrieben https://support.mozilla.org/en-US/questions/1609243

Eine einfachere Alternative wäre natürlich den Tab "Add-ons-Verwaltung" zu öffnen und unter "Themes" das helle oder das System-Theme zu aktivieren.

content: If you're not comfortable plowing through windows file explorer, I suggest one my favorite free utilities. it's called 'everything' and is at https://www.voidtools.com/ Its strength is it ability to find darn near any file within microseconds. Once started, enter abook.sqlite as that is the name of the thunderbird addressbook.(There is another file, history.sqlite, that contains the collected addresses.) Anyway, once you find abook.sqlite, you will be inside a thunderbird profile. If you stored your accounts within the profile, they would either be in the imapmail folder or mail folder, both of which are in the same folder as abook.sqlite. Now, since you stated your accounts were on the D drive, that indicates you made some custom adjustments. But this info may get you started. Good luck and post back on this thread as you make progress.
